correctness.rationale: Rebuilt all 2^9 words, filtered exactly 148 bifix-free vertices, tested 3080 mutually compatible graph edges, and independently enumerated all 1152 size-14 cliques by increasing-index bitset intersection (491170 search nodes). A separate target-15 clique search exhausted 255710 nodes and excluded any size-15 clique. Exhaustive Hamming comparisons gave histogram 1148 of d=1 and four of d=2. Complement and reversal close the four into one four-member orbit. These enumerations exhaust this finite nine-bit domain rather than extrapolating to larger lengths.
residual_risks: Result is finite for length nine; minimum Hamming distance two is not single-substitution error correction.

value.rationale: The minimum Hamming separation of a maximally large self-synchronizing code is a direct measure of substitution robustness. Showing d<=2 throughout the cardinality-maximal layer (and only four d=2 designs) is a meaningful sharp design tradeoff; it does not claim single-error correction or an all-length theorem. This is a complete natural optimum-layer classification, not merely a repeat of its known size.
